headings.description: High-impact, condensed athletic typography for headings to convey elite performance and speed. Never use generic fonts for headings.

body.description: Clean, highly readable geometric sans for body text and UI elements.

colors.description: Archetype 2: The Performance Pro. Obsidian dark anchor paired with stark white text, interrupted by high-kinetic Red and Cyan triggers.

visual_enhancers.textures: Use subtle noise/grain overlay (opacity 2-3%) across the entire site to remove digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid borders in rgba(255,255,255,0.1) for grid elements. No soft shadows. Use sharp, flat, brutalist structural lines.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used only for the sticky navigation and cart drawer backdrop. Must include backdrop-blur-xl and a subtle 1px bottom/left border.
visual_enhancers.hover_states: High-contrast flips. Black background elements flip to Primary Red with White text on hover.

grids_and_layouts.marketing_sections: Mode A: The Tetris Grid. Asymmetrical layouts with varying column spans. Overlapping product images and typography.
grids_and_layouts.product_grid: Dense but large imagery. Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4. Products should break out of their standard bounding boxes if possible.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing: p-8, p-12, p-24. Do not cramp content. Tension is created by empty space and negative space.

motion_and_interactions.scroll: Lenis for smooth, momentum-based scrolling. Essential for the premium Awwwards feel.
motion_and_interactions.hero_reveal: Framer Motion line-by-line masked text reveal. Staggered children with cubic-bezier easing.
motion_and_interactions.parallax: Framer Motion useScroll for subtle Y-axis translation on large imagery and background text.
motion_and_interactions.marquee: Slow, constant 'editorial ribbon' marquee across the screen, possibly with an outline font style (Kinetic Texture).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text on #0A0A0A meets >4.5:1 ratio. Darken images beneath text to max bg-black/50.
accessibility.focus: High visibility focus rings: focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#00C9D4].
accessibility.reduced_motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for all Framer Motion and Lenis animations.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.

header.style: Crystal Glass, fixed top-0, z-50. Must not be fully transparent.
header.classes: fixed w-full z-50 bg-[#0A0A0A]/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10

buttons.style: Sharp, brutalist rectangles. Kinetic hover (e.g., color inversion).
buttons.classes: px-8 py-4 rounded-none uppercase tracking-widest font-bold bg-[#D90012] text-white hover:bg-white hover:text-[#D90012] transition-colors

cart_drawer.style: Slide-out from right. High density. Dark surface #141414.
cart_drawer.behavior: Framer Motion slide in. Must include a 'close' button and subtle dark overlay behind it.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Dark Theme. Set body background to #0A0A0A and text to #FFFFFF.
Install and setup @studio-freight/react-lenis for smooth scrolling.
Use Framer Motion (already installed) extensively for page load text-reveals (staggered characters/lines) and scroll-triggered element reveals.
For the hero section, use a large typography lockup. 'BEAST. ROAR. LEAP. STRIKE.' Use line-by-line reveal.
Implement a fast-marquee using framer-motion or react-fast-marquee. Text should be large outline text (text-transparent stroke-white).
Product grid must look premium. Real images with high contrast. Use subtle scale on hover.
Do not use generic Shadcn cards for marketing sections. Use custom Tailwind divs with border-white/10 to create a technical/athletic bento grid.
Images MUST NOT exceed 80vh on mobile to prevent blocking content.
All interactive elements must have data-testid attributes.
Ensure 'Made in Italy' and 'Hue ColorBoost lens' are highlighted as premium tech specs in the Brand story/manifesto section.
Write code for .js and .jsx files, not .tsx.
Add GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES constraints to avoid generic designs.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not make generic centered layouts. Use asymmetry and structural grids.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Never apply universal transition (transition: all). Target specific properties.
Do not center align the app container. Left-align text naturally.
No AI emojis in the UI.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
